title: Set up an aesthetic service
summary: Unit of measure, how it is marked on the map, initial dose, limits, next appointment and aftercare.

steps.title: Menu → Sales → Services
steps.details: A service appears on the aesthetic record only if it is marked as an aesthetic service.

steps.title: Choose the service
steps.details: Tap it to open its record.

steps.title: Unit of measure
steps.details: What the applied amount is measured in (U, ml, mg…). It is required for an aesthetic service. Units are created in Clinic Catalog → Measurement Units.

steps.title: Aesthetic service
steps.details: Adds it to the aesthetic record and enables the Aesthetics tab. If you turn it off, it stops appearing for new sessions; those already recorded don't change.

steps.title: Save the service
steps.details: Saves the unit and the aesthetic flag. The Aesthetics tab settings are saved separately.

steps.title: Aesthetics
steps.details: How this service is recorded on the aesthetic record.

steps.title: Marked with
steps.details: Points (each tap is one application: toxin, lips), areas (outline of the zone: mesotherapy) or line (two ends: thread lifts).

steps.title: Initial quantity per mark
steps.details: What each new mark starts with; it can be adjusted later.

steps.title: Maximum per session
steps.details: Warns when it's exceeded during marking; it doesn't block.

steps.title: Minimum interval on a zone
steps.details: Days that should pass between applications on the same zone. This one only warns too.

steps.title: Suggested next appointment
steps.details: How many days out the follow-up is offered when closing the session; it can be given a name.

steps.title: Aftercare
steps.details: What can be sent to the patient by WhatsApp when closing the session.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: Appears when there are changes. Until it's saved for the first time, the service doesn't show on the aesthetic record.
